summary: GG2026 Phase 7: Controlled Publishing System - ALL 33 backend tests PASS. Queue-based SEO publishing with 8-15 pages/day rate limit. Day-of-week content types working correctly. Daemon running.

GET /api/publish/status.details: Returns queue stats (total/pending/scheduled/published/failed), today's schedule, daemon status (running=true, interval=30min), 7-day forecast, rate limits (8-15 per day)

POST /api/publish/enqueue.details: Adds items to queue. Slug dedup blocks pending/scheduled duplicates. Returns added/skipped counts. 400 for empty items list.

POST /api/publish/schedule.details: Assigns dates to pending items based on day-of-week rules. Accepts custom min/max_per_day. Returns scheduled count.

POST /api/publish/run.details: Publishes today's scheduled items. Returns published/failed/due_items counts.

POST /api/publish/manual.details: Override: immediately publishes specific items by queue_ids. Sets manual_override=true. Requires queue_ids (400 otherwise).

GET /api/publish/queue.details: Lists queue items with status filter (pending/scheduled/published/failed) and pagination (limit/offset). Returns total count.

POST /api/publish/remove.details: Removes pending/scheduled items from queue by queue_ids. Published items cannot be removed.

POST /api/publish/reschedule-failed.details: Moves failed items back to pending status with error cleared. Returns rescheduled count.

GET /api/publish/schedule-map.details: Returns DAY_CONTENT_MAP with all 7 days (0-6). Each day has day name, content_types list, and label.

Day-of-week content mapping.details: Mon=hub_page, Tue=company_page, Wed=guide, Thu=comparison, Fri=bonus, Sat=article, Sun=update - verified

Rate limiting 8-15/day.details: min_per_day=8, max_per_day=15 enforced. Forecast shows capacity_remaining for each day.

Daemon auto-processing.details: daemon.running=true, interval=30 min. Auto-schedules pending items and publishes due items.

Existing routes unbroken.details: All Phase 1-6 routes still working correctly

day_content_map.0: Monday = Hub Sayfalari (hub_page, intent_hub, license_hub, country_hub)
day_content_map.1: Tuesday = Firma Sayfalari (company_page, company_sub, company_x_payment, company_x_year)
day_content_map.4: Friday = Bonus Sayfalari (bonus, bonus_page, company_x_bonus, deneme-bonusu-rehberi, hosgeldin-bonusu-rehberi)

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real, no mocking used

context_for_next_testing_agent: GG2026 Phase 7 Controlled Publishing System complete. MongoDB collection: publish_queue. Statuses: pending → scheduled → publishing → published/failed. Daemon runs every 30 min, auto-schedules pending and publishes due items. Priority 1=highest, 10=lowest. Published items can be re-queued (dedup only checks pending/scheduled). Schedule looks up to 30 days ahead for valid slot.
